message.
u
Hello, Mr. Callaghan, @this is Connor, from Ballyway Hotel
in Dublin about the company retreat you've booked with us
for the first week of October. @1’m calling to confirm that
you're still reserving a block of rooms for thirty people. If
the number has changed at all, please let me know. Also,
know you were considering a welcome dinner for the first
night of the meeting. If you're still interested in that, ®you
can view our menu options on the hotel’s Web site. Please
give me a call back when you have a chance. The number
is 555-0101.
context.transcript_translation:
信息。
您好，Callaghan 先生，我是来自都柏林 Ballyway Hotel 的 Connor。关于您预订的十月第一周的公司度假活动，我致电确认一下。我想确认您是否仍然为三十人保留了一批房间。如果人数有任何变动，请告诉我。另外，我知道您考虑在会议的第一晚举办欢迎晚宴。如果您仍然感兴趣，可以在酒店网站上查看我们的菜单选项。请您方便的时候回电给我。电话是 555-0101。
